# polaris_principal_role_assignment (Resource)

Manage one Polaris role assignment. Other assignments remain independently owned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_principal_role_assignment" "member" {
  principal      = "existing-entra-object-id"
  principal_role = "analysts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal` (String) Existing Polaris principal name.
- `principal_role` (String) Existing Polaris principal_role name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_principal_role_assignment.member '["existing-entra-object-id","analysts"]'
```
